responsibility: Declares the checked fixed-width integer arithmetic helpers used by the D front end support code. It exposes signed and unsigned 32-bit and 64-bit add, subtract, negate, and multiply routines that report overflow via a sticky boolean reference while returning the truncated machine-width result.
same_name_distinction: Declares the checked integer helper APIs and overload sets for 32-bit and 64-bit operations; unlike checkedint.c, it does not implement the overflow checks themselves.
